scope: Japanese J1 in configs/analysis-scope.json. Register before reading the complete R15 historical holdout and before the November 25 seven J1 matches finish. The prospective targets are all ten November 28/29 fixtures already registered in the second comprehensive window.
historical_pair: Use the same full R15 two-head coefficients fitted before 2024 and the same three doses chosen on 2024 for both arms. Hold the R7 distribution, original comparator choices, true line and information about the target fixture fixed. The current-information arm uses only strictly earlier source dates. The other arm restricts the R15 form and personnel history to source dates strictly before target date minus seven calendar days. The latter restriction affects all six R15 features and both teams. The R7 anchor is held fixed to identify the marginal value of the updated R15 features. Recompute the published R15 forecasts under the first arm and verify their identities and choices.
historical_population: All original 380 matches in 2025 and all 150 recent matches in the original November 21 R5 panel. Keep separate fold denominators. Compute scores, ordered-three, WDL, measured total full win and its five outcomes, market coverage, gains and losses with date-cluster intervals. Use R15's existing first-probability ranking and source dates for per-seat and whole-batch counts. Also report matches where information changes and the original starting-XI coverage on each side. No model or intensity is chosen from this comparison.
forward_pair: Use all ten registered weekend fixtures with identical original R5 market and R7 score grids. The comparator is each signed pre-update R15 first. Use the exact published R15 full-panel coefficients and validation doses for both. At a new real cutoff after the seven November 25 fixtures finish, append their dated J1 appearances only if officially authenticated regulation scores are available. Verify the actual starters by the same eleven unique IDs and football positions as R15, independently per side. If a confirmed prior fixture lacks proven starters it occupies its calendar slot and its roster remains missing. The seven earlier games can enter form and player history only after genuine FT evidence. Use their original prematch anchor to compute residuals. Check the full J1 calendar from Nov 22 to Nov 25 for other appearances, document any unresolved coverage, and use only verified prior fixtures. Record prior hashes, changed features, predicted first and ordered alternatives, original market/WDL/total, and new immutable first on this research track. The initial R15 weekend predictions and the earlier comprehensive windows retain their original versions.
prospective_selection: Freeze all ten research predictions and first-probability ranks before the earliest weekend kickoff, after qualifying evidence is captured. Rank up to three fixtures by probability of the unique primary score, then full original event ID. Per-seat first hits and ordered-three hits, three primary scores all correct, scheduled/eligible/filled slots and unpriced fixtures remain distinct.
decision: Retain all windows including zero denominators and failed hypotheses. Separate historical cutoff sensitivity from prospective performance and the project's actual user-facing firsts. No active model switch or change of four-stage thresholds.
